title: Article 149 — Duties and powers of the Comptroller and Auditor-General

content.overview: Article 149 provides that the Comptroller and Auditor-General shall perform such duties and exercise such powers in relation to the accounts of the Union and of the States and of any other authority or body as may be prescribed by or under any law made by Parliament and, until provision in that behalf is so made, shall perform such duties and exercise such powers in relation to the accounts of the Union and of the States as were conferred on or exercisable by the Auditor-General of India immediately before the commencement of the Constitution in relation to the accounts of the Dominion of India and of the Provinces respectively.
content.glance: CAG’s duties and powers regarding accounts of Union, States, and other authorities — as prescribed by parliamentary law (interim: pre-Constitution Auditor-General powers).
content.study:
Article 149 duties and powers:
- Relates to accounts of the Union, the States, and any other authority or body as Parliament by law provides.
- Until parliamentary law provides otherwise, CAG exercises the powers of the pre-Constitution Auditor-General in relation to Dominion/Provincial accounts.
- Detailed audit mandate is in the CAG’s (Duties, Powers and Conditions of Service) Act and related law.

Examination: parliamentary prescription of duties; Union and State accounts; other bodies as by law; transitional continuance.

sections.heading: Key rule
sections.body: CAG performs duties and exercises powers in relation to accounts of the Union, States, and other authorities as prescribed by parliamentary law (until then, pre-Constitution Auditor-General powers apply to Union/State accounts).

questionsAndAnswers.question: What are the duties of the CAG under Article 149?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 149, the Comptroller and Auditor-General shall perform such duties and exercise such powers in relation to the accounts of the Union and of the States and of any other authority or body as may be prescribed by or under any law made by Parliament. Until such provision is made, the CAG performs the duties and exercises the powers which were conferred on or exercisable by the Auditor-General of India immediately before the commencement of the Constitution in relation to the accounts of the Dominion of India and of the Provinces.

examTips: Duties as prescribed by Parliament; Union, States, and other bodies by law.

keyTakeaways: Art 149: CAG duties and powers as to accounts.
